MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 12, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55430  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, May 8, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55437  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record,
  conclude the public hearing, consider the Appeal from Erik Toso; and deny the
  Appeal and uphold the Marine Bureau’s decision to terminate his permit for
  violation of Long Beach Marina Rules and Regulations effective June 15, 2025.
  (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55434  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver in an amount not
  to exceed $10,000.00, for use of dock space in Alamitos Bay Marina for
  visiting/participating vessels during the 2025 Ullman Sails Long Beach Race Week,
  for period of June 19 – June 22, 2025. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55433  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver for the Seal
  Beach Yacht Club (SLBYC), in an amount not to exceed $2,160.00, for use of 108
  parking spaces in Alamitos Bay Marina for The Charity Regatta Swap Meet on July
  12, 2025. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55431  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 12, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55432  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55436  Recommendation to elect Commission members of the Marine Advisory
  Commission; for Executive, Finance, Maintenance/Operations, and Tidelands
  Capital Projects Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
